judged_text: The new-guest detection compares attendee.email against newGuests case-sensitively, so a guest entered with different casing than the stored attendee email receives the 'guests added' notification email instead of the full scheduled-email body with event details. A newly added guest whose email was stored with different casing gets a body with no event details/CTA rather than AttendeeScheduledEmail's full invitation content, confusing the primary recipient of the change.

adjudication.rationale: In sendAddGuestsEmails the check `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` is indeed case-sensitive, but the diff shows newly created attendees are persisted with `email: guest` exactly as provided (`guestsFullDetails`), and `sendAddGuestsEmails` is called with that same `guests` array, so there’s no demonstrated path where a newly added guest’s stored email casing differs and causes misclassification. Also, the claim that AttendeeAddGuestsEmail has “no event details/CTA” is not supported: `AttendeeAddGuestsEmail` wraps `AttendeeScheduledEmail` and does not remove the CTA (only OrganizerAddGuestsEmail sets `callToAction={null}`).
